meta.title: Cursor rules
meta.description: Loads the workspace's .cursor/rules/*.mdc files into the agent context with Cursor's four rule types, and adds a panel for reading and toggling them. Rules marked alwaysApply are injected at the start of a session; rules with globs are added after the agent reads or edits a matching file; rules with only a description are offered on demand. The files are read from disk, and the injected rules become part of the conversation sent to the model; nothing is uploaded. Turning the bundle off stops both the injection and the sidebar button.
